sections.title: The Human Skull
points: The skull is made of 22 separate bones.
Cranium: The 'Brain Box' part of the skull that houses the brain.
Mandible: The lower jawbone. It is the only movable bone in the skull.
Sutures: The fixed, saw-like joints that hold skull bones together rigidly.

sections.title: The Backbone (Vertebral Column)
points: It forms the central axis of the body.
It protects the Spinal Cord and supports the head.
It consists of small bones called Vertebrae.
Total vertebrae: 33 (in infants) which fuse into 26 separate bones in adults.

sections.title: The 5 Regions of the Spine
points: 1. Cervical (Neck): 7 bones. Includes the Atlas (holds head) and Axis (turns head).
2. Thoracic (Chest): 12 bones. This is where the ribs attach.
3. Lumbar (Abdomen): 5 bones. These are the largest vertebrae to support weight.

sections.text: The spine is flexible because it is made of many small vertebrae separated by cartilage discs. One solid bone would make you unable to bend!

sections.title: Skull & Spine Protection Summary
points: The Inner Ear is encased deep within the skull bones for protection.
The Neural Canal is the hole in the vertebrae where the spinal cord passes.

cards.fact: The only movable bone in your head.
There are exactly 7 bones in the neck.
Immovable saw-like joints in the skull.
